newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE expects higher full-year 96/97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: RWE expects higher full-year 96/97 earnings.

text.p: German diversified utility group RWE AG said on Wednesday that it expected its full year earnings in the 1996/97 business year to rise from year-ago levels.
"We expect that full-year earnings will be higher overall than in the previous year," the group said in its interim report for the first half of the year to the end of December.
The group also said that its results included costs for its telecommunications business of 82 million marks, and that it expected higher telecoms costs in the second half of 1996/97.
